input.scientific_wire: shortest decimal string for every scale/RHS f64, parsed by Rust FromStr

domain.scale: positive normal power of two >= rigorous squared-norm upper
domain.invalid: structured request error before a false-success solve

policies.label: PLAIN_STOP
policies.rule: Initial4 CG, ordinary readout only; no certification.

policies.label: PLAIN_ALWAYS
policies.rule: Initial4 CG and ordinary initial readout; fixed additional CG then ordinary final readout.

policies.label: FAST_ONCE
policies.rule: Initial4 CG plus fast enclosure; certify/return or same fixed continuation and ordinary final readout as PLAIN_ALWAYS.

policies.label: FAST_BLOCK
policies.rule: Initial4 CG plus fast enclosure; repeat after blocks8 up to same additional cap; strict certificate or identical final ell fallback.

policies.label: OUTWARD_BLOCK
policies.rule: Same checkpoints/solver and common cheap input validation as FAST_BLOCK; use inherited full outward evaluator with raw clipping and certified residual upper.

policies.label: RESIDUAL
policies.rule: Initial4 CG then common recursive relative tolerance1e-8 cap512; fast fresh response/relative upper; goal flag only if its upper meets tolerance.

arithmetic.ordinary_stencil: diagonal product; north,south,west,east neighbour product and subtraction
arithmetic.error_scalars: outward operations only after the ordinary pass; exact abs/max reductions
arithmetic.residual_upper: outward sqrt(DU)/sqrt(BL), never DU/BL before sqrt

diagnostics.residual_upper: array for final FAST/OUTWARD evaluation; null for final PLAIN
diagnostics.residual_goal_met: bool derived only from certified upper; null for final PLAIN

timing.execution: every policy is physically executed; warmup1 and repeats9 in cyclic order; no cross-policy state reuse

verification.known_underflow: bmax2^-600 fixture must reject with explicit norm-range error, never residual_goal_met=true
required: ordinary controls have no interval counts or certified goal
verification.source_code_policy: No existing source/Cargo change; parent owns integration and pushes.
